name: Threat of Starvation
summary: Hagiak asks you to bring stolen supplies from Outcast Hideaway to the Magram Front. He intends to use them to weaken the exiles and advance the Magram clan’s plans.

sections.title: The Magram's Aim
sections.body: Hagiak sends you toward Outcast Hideaway for supplies, while asking you to keep your standing with the Magram. He sees the exiles as foes and expects their defeat to bring the hideaway under Magram control. He also hopes to raise an army against the other clans.

sections.title: At the Front
sections.body: At the Magram Front, Hagiak inspects the crates you bring back. Some contain food, and he believes that will shorten the exiles’ time there. He sees the Magram’s victory as nearer.

faq.answer: Hagiak asks you to bring supplies to him at the Magram Front.

faq.q: Where do the supplies come from?
faq.answer: Hagiak sends you to Outcast Hideaway to fetch supplies.
Hagiak asks you to bring six stolen supplies back to the Magram Front.

faq.q: Why does Hagiak want the supplies?
faq.answer: Hagiak believes the supplies will shorten the exiles’ time at the hideaway.

faq.q: What does Hagiak want for the Magram?
faq.answer: Hagiak wants the Magram to secure the hideaway and raise an army against the other clans.

attribution: In-game quest text: Threat of Starvation
